name: Forest Fortress
source:
Our protagonist Dale goes to the cursed forest to learn more about the origins of a disease that affected a neighbouring village. In his search Dale meets a squirrel-girl Rika, who warns him of the dangers. She advises him to leave the forest before the dark - otherwise the protagonist may end up like dark dryads. However her warning came too late…

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1933372300/forest-fortress-live2d-animated-novel]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
translation:
主人公Dale前往受诅咒的森林，调查波及邻近村庄的一场疾病的起源。寻找线索时，他遇到松鼠女孩Rika，对方向他警告其中的危险。她劝他在天黑之前离开森林，否则可能落得与黑暗树精相同的下场。然而，她的警告来得太迟了……

[整理自：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1933372300/forest-fortress-live2d-animated-novel]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
